subject: Quick RSVP Sprint — high-intent list activation
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@scalecloud.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick idea — co-host outreach to your hot list?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — our audience responded well to the latency/cost framing. We have a small set of mutual customers and high-intent leads who asked for a short technical session focused on dedicated capacity economics.

Thought: DevSummits has a June 30 slot — would Redwood be open to a 30-minute co-hosted "High-Intent Sprint" (brief demo + panel)? We can help activate a warm list of ~500 prospects (we'll share the CSV) and manage registration pages + tracking.

If yes, we can push a 3-touch RSVP sprint (initial invite, reminder, last-chance). Sample timelines attached.

Quick Qs:
- Do you want us to host the registration page or send traffic to your page?
- Any mandatory security/compliance copy we need to include?

We're flexible — can jump on a 15-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Emily Park
Partnerships Lead, ScaleCloud
emily@scalecloud.ai

Attachment: sprint_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <emily@scalecloud.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick idea — co-host outreach to your hot list?

Emily — thanks for the note and for lining this up. Good fit.

Quick answers:
- We prefer to drive RSVPs to our registration page so we capture UTM/source and attribute signups. If DevSummits can push traffic and use our link, great.
- No extra security copy required for marketing invites; if the audience is enterprise, we'll include a short "data handling" blurb at registration.

Operational ask (high-priority sprint):
- Monica: can you own list ingestion and segmentation? We'll need the 500 CSV mapped (email, company, role, intent score).
- Marissa: you run comms cadence and tracking links — see suggested UTM scheme below.
- Vivek: ops support to ensure registration page capacity and streaming tokens for the live demo.

Suggested UTM pattern (please confirm):
- utm_source=devsummits
- utm_medium=partner_email
- utm_campaign=hsrsvp_june30
- utm_content={variant}  (we'll A/B subject lines)

Attachments to collect from ScaleCloud: the hotlist CSV and any co-branding logos. Please share HubSpot record for the primary contact (Emily).

If that all sounds good I'll draft the invite copy and two subject variants for A/B testing. Can we aim for the initial invite to go 6/25, reminder 6/28, last-chance 6/29?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync.

--
Avery Johnson
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Thanks team — love the sprint approach. A couple of quick ops notes and copy in-thread.

Copy variants (short):
A
Subject: See how Redwood cuts inference unit cost by 3-5x — exclusive 30-min sprint
Preheader: Limited seats — live demo + customer panel (June 30)
Body snippet: Join Redwood and ScaleCloud for a focused 30-minute session on driving predictable inference cost with dedicated pools. We'll show cost breakdowns, production rollouts, and a brief live demo. RSVP now — spots limited.

B
Subject: Quick technical sprint: dedicated GPU economics for platform teams
Preheader: Practical tactics for latency and unit-cost wins (30 mins)
Body snippet: A hands-on conversation for platform teams — how to pick quantization and batching profiles that save 30%+ on token costs. Live demo + short Q&A. RSVP.

Tracking links (examples):
- https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_source=devsummits&utm_medium=partner_email&utm_campaign=hsrsvp_june30&utm_content=variantA
- https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_source=devsummits&utm_medium=partner_email&utm_campaign=hsrsvp_june30&utm_content=variantB

Reminders cadence: initial invite (6/25), reminder (6/28), last-chance (6/29 morning). Use dynamic insert for role-specific snippet (see Monica's buckets).

Ops notes for Vivek: please pre-warm the registration flow and ensure webinar token limit set to 2,000 concurrent registrations. We'll need live token stream for the demo environment set to test keys so we don't surface customer data.

Emily — if ScaleCloud can send the hotlist to Monica and confirm co-brand logos, we'll finalize creative and schedule send windows.

I'll upload the email_variants_v2.docx to the Drive link and post the final HubSpot campaign id once created.

Thanks — sending draft to Emily now.

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Demand Gen Manager | Redwood Inference
